messages:
elaine.k: Quick sync — I sketched a prototype that surfaces origin metadata for every request with an `x-rw-origin-project` header so we can do better quota attribution and route to project-affinity pools. Thoughts?
ryan: Do we plan to trust that header from external clients? seems spoofable. :thinking_face:
maria: +1 on the goal. we should prefer embedding org/project in the token JWT claims and fallback to header only for internal infra hops.
samir: Agreed — if we require signed claims we get strong provenance. example JWT claim: `{\"org\":\"org_123\",\"proj\":\"proj_789\"}`. token introspection on edge would validate.
elaine.k: Token claims is ideal but we have lots of backwards-compat clients. Proposal: accept header for now but only when request arrives from our proxy (verify TLS client cert or mTLS), otherwise ignore.
ryan: That works. Also need routing policy: if header+claim disagree, prefer claim and emit a metric `auth.origin_conflict`.
maria: UX ask: Console should show a table of requests with inferred origin (claim/header/none) and an actionable button to rebind keys to projects in bulk. Product wants to avoid surprise quota charges.
samir: On routing side, we can add a sticky affinity to route by project for 10m TTL to keep KV caches warm. fallback routing to default pool if missing.
elaine.k: Love the sticky idea. add knobs: affinity TTL, max per-node-project-count, and a circuit-breaker if a project overloads a pool.
ryan: Telemetry: sample 1% of requests and always sample auth failures and origin_conflict events. Log schema: `ts | key_id | org | proj_claim | proj_header | route_pool | latency_ms | auth_result`
maria: Console UX: bulk-bind flow mock: select keys -> choose project -> preview estimated monthly quota impact -> confirm. show diff with prior routing.
samir: Small implementation note — introspection latency must be sub-ms. we'll cache token->claims for token TTL and keep cache invalidation on rotation.
elaine.k: Security: rotation windows mean we must honor short TTLs. consider JWK-set caching with aggressive refresh + backoff.
ryan: For rollout: feature flag behind `auth.origin_provenance` with canary on 10% orgs then 50% then all. deploy-bot: canary started for `auth-service` on stack `canary-7` (build bld-2026.3.18). :rocket:
maria: Can we surface in console which orgs are in each rollout cohort? product wants visibility.
elaine.k: Yes — we'll add a rollout view that lists cohorts + toggles and a diffable plan export.
samir: One last thought: metrics attribution must be idempotent across retries. include a `x-rw-request-id` that the router echoes so billing dedup can operate.
ryan: Ok sounds like action items: (1) implement token-claim preference + header-only-from-proxy, (2) add origin_conflict metric & sampling, (3) sticky routing TTL knobs, (4) console bulk-bind mock + rollout view. I'll open tickets.
maria: Thanks — I'll pair with design on the mock tomorrow.
elaine.k: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the prototype PR and a short design doc with the rollout plan.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: `auth-service` canary started at 1713002555, targets: auth-origin-provenance flag ON for cohort 10%. Logs: https://ci.redwood-infra/builds/4578
